metadata.description: The murderboard and the gates that keep it honest.

plugins.name: murderboard
plugins.description: An adversarial review harness for document deliverables — explainers, methods text, figures and their captions, reports, handoffs. /murderboard runs eleven reviewer roles, checks every claim against a real source rather than against the draft, and gates its own output so a run that fired 7 of 11 roles cannot pass as a clean one.
